trust_decision.summary: Whether a hook file name (CLI arg or directory entry) resolves to a regular file inside the per-type hooks directory under prefix/configDirectory before it is deleted, opened in an editor/chmod'ed, or executed; decided ad hoc in each hooks subcommand and in processHooks in cmd/uniget/hooks.go, with no shared helper.

landing_point.why: 'Path Traversal in Hook Files' leads straight to the hooks subcommands that join args[0] onto the hooks dir; remove (hookFileName := args[0] then os.Remove) is the first obvious one.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `uniget hooks edit` (UNIGET_EDITOR/EDITOR split; command-injection part of the same commit)

processHooks, reached by `uniget hooks list`, `uniget hooks run`, and the install/uninstall hook runners (cmd/uniget/install.go:266, cmd/uniget/install.go:459, cmd/uniget/uninstall.go:48, cmd/uniget/uninstall.go:90)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared internal helper in the same file (directory iterator)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All fix sites are in cmd/uniget/hooks.go; processHooks (cmd/uniget/hooks.go:407-433) is a shared helper but sits in the same file and is reached from install/uninstall, not a separate implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: `hooks test` is an admin debugging command that runs a named hook by hand, and `hooks add` takes only the basename of --source, so a solver can argue neither is a 'hook file traversal' route like remove/edit.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Regular (non-symlink) hook files in each hooks/*.d directory must still be listed, run by `hooks run` and by install/uninstall, edited and removed; the published Lstat check (err == nil -> reject) rejects every existing file, so an over-broad or copied fix breaks all hook execution and editing of existing hooks (TestProcessHooks covers the processHooks path).

O6_input_shapes: relative traversal in the CLI name argument (../ segments) for remove and edit, via filepath.Abs + prefix check (fix.diff:21-27, fix.diff:58-64)
symlinked hook file for edit and for directory entries processed by processHooks, via os.Lstat (fix.diff:65-68, fix.diff:79-82)
EDITOR value containing spaces/extra args: only the first token is kept (fix.diff:48, fix.diff:70)

O7_producer.where: Hook paths are built inline by string concatenation in each command (cmd/uniget/hooks.go:94, cmd/uniget/hooks.go:147, cmd/uniget/hooks.go:340); configDirectory is set in rootCmd PersistentPreRunE (cmd/uniget/main.go:108-147) which every command runs.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `hooks test --type T <name> args...` joins args[0] onto the hooks dir and passes it to runHook, which executes it, with no containment or symlink check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Debug/test command the admin runs deliberately on their own hook; advisory examples are remove/edit.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: runHook, the shared executor, does only fileExists (os.Stat, follows symlinks) before exec.Command, so a direct caller (hooks test) bypasses the processHooks symlink check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Low-level helper that 'expects already validated input' because processHooks checks before calling it.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `hooks add` writes via myos.CopyFile (os.Create) and os.Chmod to the destination hook path; a pre-existing symlink at that name is followed, while edit got an Lstat guard for the same case.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Destination name is the basename of --source so ../ traversal is impossible; symlink planting needs write access to the hooks dir.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; write primitive in pkg/os/io.go:114-137

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The published containment check is strings.HasPrefix(abs, hooksDir) without a trailing separator, so a sibling directory sharing the prefix (e.g. etc/uniget-x) passes; same check copied to both sites.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like a correct Abs+prefix check; the sibling-name case needs a directory the user does not normally have.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-tool hook lookup (e.g. hooks/<tool>.d/<name>) built from the tool name and executed via runHook
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: install already hands tool names to hook runners; a per-tool hook directory is a natural feature request.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CopyFile/Move helper used by hooks add/import that resolves the destination from user input
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the helper comments say 'Low-level copy expects sanitation', so a caller in another package could skip it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `hooks show <name>` / cat subcommand that reads a named hook file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: list already exists; displaying a single hook's contents is a plausible sibling command written by copy-paste of remove.
